tools.name: find_answer
tools.description: Searches Loan My Coins's published answers and returns up to five, word for word as the site publishes them, best first, each with its page url. Only approved published content is returned; an empty answers list means no published answer matches. Deterministic; no model.

findings.title: Description uses pressure/override language
findings.detail: Description of "prepare_introduction" stacks urgency/override words (always, never). Legitimate tool descriptions rarely pressure the model to act or ignore prior guidance.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: find_answer · Private data: read_reality_check · Public sink: evaluate_btc_loan, prepare_introduction.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: find_answer · Private data: read_reality_check · Public sink: evaluate_btc_loan, prepare_introduction

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
